direction: Whole natural seahorse with coherent horse head, short tubular snout and curled prehensile tail, beside a narrow kelp blade. Broad parallel wavy mould grain as material detail. Oval rim echoes the seahorse body and natural cuttlebone form, short dash marks, leaf hands, trail charge and folio calendar. Compact companion is one open kelp-blade tip crossed by three short wavy mould-grain fragments; no whole animal, ring, coin, cast sprue or enclosing plaque. Calendar badge adapts independently; date sizing never determines clock face.
